title: Do not buy for AI plan
body: Not customizable the app gives you a different uncustomizable plan each week. It just says leg day on Wednesday for example. What if you don’t train on Wednesday? the app doesn’t care, you only mark tasks complete or delete them. You cannot delete future task so you can only delete them on the day it’s due. Not 1 routine if you want to live by the plan your live is different everyday, not 1 routine aspect. Different workout days every week, different challenges, and don’t get me wrong, the challenges and things it gives are great improvements but it is so random. 1 day you have a cold shower, other day you meditate, then a day you journal, than you have a speaking exercise. There’s no routine. Own tasks you can add your own tasks which is a saver. The downside is that your own tasks are also weekly and you have to put in your weekly tasks every week again, and because you can’t delete the tasks the app gave you it is a mess. Push-ups to open apps doesn’t work one of the ads for the app is that you can select apps that need for instance push-ups to unlock. This just doesn’t work. If you enable focus mode the apps lock which it’s great but there’s no way to open them while on focus mode, they’re just locked. There’s no in between, it’s open or locked. I bought it for 30 euros for a year in sale, worth? Depends, for the AI plan? No. For speaking coaching and challenges to improve overall? Yes, but not worth the 8 euros a week you have to pay without sale.
